findings.description: Jean-Baptiste Cupis was buried on 1 May 1788 at Montreuil (now Montreuil, Seine-Saint-Denis), France, the day after his death on 30 April 1788; the parish entry indexes him as Jean Baptiste de Cupis, born about 1710.
supporting_sources: France, Seine-Saint-Denis, Parish and Civil Registration, 1523-1932 — burial entry for Jean Baptiste de Cupis, 1 May 1788 (ark:/61903/1:1:DRKL-YZMM)
